## Batch 94 complete

Authored the A/B pair: eight A items and one ring example, with both pages, the refreshed manifest, proof contracts, source coverage, cross-batch input and batch notes. The notes record two corrections to the design’s item dependency routes and the scope checks.

All nine items have current `ready` records (`owner: false`). The scoped dependency calculation confirms levels 0–5; the required batch-level dependency on batch 88 remains level 2. Source coverage is stamped and verified 8/8, with no drops. Sources include [Seifert’s 2017 lecture notes](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1707.03759) and [Lebowitz–Spohn](https://arxiv.org/pdf/cond-mat/9811220).

Scoped proof-layout, precheck, strict proof-contract, rendering, content-policy, dependency and manifest checks pass. Independent review remains pending.
